mapper.select: SELECT sp.real_name as name, CASE WHEN AVG(ss.personal_score) >= 85 THEN '高级' WHEN AVG(ss.personal_score) >= 70 THEN '中级' ELSE '初级' END as level, '提升毽球综合技能' as goal FROM users u INNER JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.id = u.id LEFT JOIN shuttlecock_skills ss ON ss.student_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{studentId} AND u.role = 'STUDENT' GROUP BY u.id, sp.real_name

SELECT skill_type, ROUND(personal_score, 1) as personal_score, ROUND(class_avg_score, 1) as class_avg_score FROM shuttlecock_skills WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND personal_score < 75 ORDER BY personal_score ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, action_type, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(result_data, '$.score')) as score FROM practice_records WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
